_readme: Everything about a hero controller EXCEPT its silhouette. The four plates in
_includes/art/hero-pad-*.svg are geometry only; they carry no <text>, so the
art can be redrawn or swapped without re-embedding a word of copy.
Consumed by _includes/bands/hero.html (annotations, face-button letters,
plate alt text) and _includes/bands/capabilities.html (face-slot glyphs).
copy   : the annotation prose, written ONCE. A left stick moves the cursor
whichever controller it is on, so the same entry is cited by all
four pads instead of being duplicated four times. accent:true is
the '+ ' software-extra treatment (--accent-ink), and it belongs to
the string, not to the pad that shows it.
callouts: side l|r picks the layout guide (x=312 right-aligned, x=888
left-aligned); y is the LABEL baseline in viewBox units, the body
line sits 18 below it. seq is the fade-in order, d1..d8, and it is
not always the reading order (see mf).
letters: face-button caps, keyed by the PlayStation glyph in the same
POSITION, which is how home.js maps them too. x/y are the baseline
in viewBox units. plate is the tint on the drawn pad (muted studio
paint); glyph is the tint on the 26px .face-slot icon (the site's
saturated tokens). They are different colours on purpose: two
surfaces, two palettes, one letter.

holdOne.label: HOLD ONE BUTTON
holdOne.body: like Shift: every other button changes

leftStick.label: LEFT STICK
leftStick.body: moves the cursor, smooth and steady

rightStick.label: RIGHT STICK
rightStick.body: scrolls the page, at your speed

everyButton.label: EVERY BUTTON
everyButton.body: any shortcut, app, or saved task

quietBuzz.label: A QUIET BUZZ
quietBuzz.body: at the volume ceiling, and as you flip through apps

twoButtons.label: TWO BUTTONS
twoButtons.body: press two at once: one more job

tapOrHold.label: TAP OR HOLD
tapOrHold.body: two jobs on the same button

firmTriggers.label: + FIRM TRIGGERS
firmTriggers.body: turn them on and they push back

touchpad.label: + TOUCHPAD
touchpad.body: taps and gestures, like a trackpad

tilt.label: + TILT TO POINT
tilt.body: aim by moving your hands, not a stick

xb.alt: Stylized Xbox controller, its controls mapped to Mac inputs

sw.alt: Stylized Switch Pro controller, its controls mapped to Mac inputs

mf.alt: Outline of a generic controller standing in for most other controllers that pair with a Mac
